Sighting(s) Notes: Doe and her fawn came into the field from the path. Far back corner. Ran off and came back at about 7:51.

Doe came down the trail from the director Hogan’s towards the culverts. Walked under the stand. Shot at 20yds. Downed. 

The buck showed up in the field shortly after but was spooked by something and ran off. 

The something was a coyote. Traveling along trail towards Daniel’s stand. Shot at and hit tree limb. Miss. 

The buck came back into the field. Shot at 40 yards. Short. Miss.
She was around 70yds back in the swamp sort of towards the culvert

Buck came up from behind left shoulder on same side of the creek as me.  It was less than 10yds and I spooked it trying to get into position.  It ran behind me and circled around and we stared at each other for a while before it ran off directly behind the stand.
Buck showed up at the corn pile while I had my head down after I had pissed right off of the stand...
Harvest Notes:: He was close (10yds) and we stared at each other a while.  He bobbed his head and stomped.  I eventually got a shot over a limb that was in the way.  3 point rack

Sighting(s) Notes: Watched a small buck at 30yds.  Then another buck at dusk.  Shot/hit the buck at dusk.  Broke bolt, no harvest.
Watched a deer around the corn pile but too dark to make out more than a dark body

Harvest Notes:: Tracked it for a while, gut shot

Sighting(s) Notes: Heard deer walking well before sunrise.  Full moon allowed me to see it come up from behind my right shoulder, into top corner of ridge, and down the path.  All before sunrise.
Saw what I thought was a doe (turned out to be a spike, but low light and tiny antlers) walk from the swamp to the bail blind field.  Could have shot, glad I didn't.
Buck came up from behind right shoulder (from pond) into the trail I had just walked to the stand on 2 hours earlier.
Harvest Notes:: He did not look interested in entering the field, shot him as he was heading back into the woods behind the stand.  Ran/stumbled down the hill to the pond.  NOTE: I will not hunt up top alone ever again.

Sighting(s) Notes: Deer came from Daniel's stand, down trail, but did not stop as it went straight towards the gun club property.

(orientation: looking towards shit stand) Buck came from behind right shoulder, near the trail, stayed in the woods and walked all the way around (avoiding the trail) and went back to the swamp over left shoulder.

Buck with single, largeish antler was passing behind me.  Probably wouldn't have come into the field, busted me trying to get a better look and ran off back towards Oak Ridge stand.

Spike showed up behind me, coming towards me at 9:40am.  Never busted me, but it was windy and he was skittish, ran off back up the hill and towards the Shit Stand.
She walked right in front of the stand, did not stop.  Walking from Bail Blind field towards the swamp.  Passed even though I had her in my sights.  Regretted it.
5 does came into field from direction of hunt club and returned the same way
